title: Computation Note: Amount of the Rental Vehicle Coordination Delay Goodwill Credit
content:
**Computation.** On a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental tied to a network customer-pay repair that was held up, the credited delay days are the business days (Monday to Friday) by which the repair's ready date fell after its target, counted from the repair start date less the repair tier's target turnaround in business days and never below zero, but no more than the class goodwill credit authority days; each credited day is valued at the time charge posted on the final invoice less every credit standing on the rental, divided by the days posted on the time charge, plus the lost-day fee value; and the delay goodwill credit is 0.5 (one half) of that value. The lost-day fee value is the young-renter charge standing on the rental divided by the rental days, or zero where no young-renter charge stands. Rental days are the whole days between the pickup date and the return date, plus one where the return time as counted is later than the pickup time of day.

The credit is never more than the class goodwill credit authority days at the class partner daily rate less goodwill already credited on the rental, and never more than the time charge still standing after the credits against it; it is never below zero and is rounded to the cent once at the end.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Repair start date, ready date, target turnaround of the repair's service tier | The repair order under Customer-Pay Repairs the rental is tied to |
| Time charge posted on the final invoice and the days posted on it | The customer's uncovered-days charge on the final invoice |
| Every credit standing on the rental | All customer credits on the rental, whatever their reason |
| Young-renter charge standing | The customer charge of kind young-renter on the rental |
| Goodwill already credited | The customer credits with reason goodwill on the rental |
| Class goodwill credit authority days and partner daily rate | The desk authority table and the class rate schedule |

The business days are each Monday-to-Friday day after the repair start date, up to and including the ready date.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

An Economy Rental (partner daily rate 39.99 USD, goodwill credit authority 1 rental day) of 8 rental days carries a final time charge of 400.00 USD posted for 8 days, credits standing of 40.00 USD and a young-renter charge of 200.00 USD. The repair ran 3 business days past its target, so the credited delay days are 1. The day is valued at 360.00 USD divided by 8, 45.00 USD, plus 200.00 USD divided by 8, 25.00 USD, together 70.00 USD; one half of that is 35.00 USD. The limits are 39.99 USD and 360.00 USD, so the credit is 35.00 USD.

Had a goodwill credit of 10.00 USD already stood as well, the credits standing would be 50.00 USD, the day would be valued at 43.75 USD plus 25.00 USD, half of that being 34.375 USD, and the limit of 39.99 USD less 10.00 USD would hold the credit at 29.99 USD.
